item.tib: gtsug gtor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gyi rgyud la gta' chen
item.coloph: kun grol grags pa gta' chen bca' bkrol sbyang ba'i rim pa 'di/ mched grogs dam pa khro bla nor bu dang / drung yig ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho yis/ bskul phyir kun grol grags pa'i dpar des so/ 'di brtsams dge bas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba 'di'i/ 'khor ba'i mtsho sgrol thar pa'i lam la bkod/ sangs rgyas sa thob 'khrul rtogs dbyings su sangs/ bde chen klong thim bon nyid ngang du bde/ ces gtsug gtor gdugs dkar can gyi bdud rtsi gta' chen bca' bkrol 'di yang bkra shis ri khrod du bgyis pa dge'o// 1 sngon 'gro dug p
